sentences: Wadge games compare two languages by asking players to construct objects whose membership outcomes correspond.
This project concerns languages of infinite labeled trees recognized by Muller tree automata.
It asks whether determinacy of all such games can be proved within ordinary ZFC set theory or requires stronger assumptions.
The source establishes independence phenomena for related counter-automaton word games, which do not automatically cover regular tree languages.
Resolving the tree case would locate the set-theoretic strength hidden in games defined by finite automata.
